obligation.meaning: 回収権なし/通常権ありの回答者が切断しても、退避復帰や経過時刻のalarmで回答を自動消費せず、全員の明示回答を待つ。

t:a700c1c1c5d44fba.title: Recovery disconnect never auto-passes a no-claim actor
t:a700c1c1c5d44fba.bindingNote: Authenticated snapshot sockets close, room eviction and real alarm at mocked elapsed 0/60s/1day leave stored game unchanged in no-right/base-right worlds. Every seat still explicitly passes; ACK replay is idempotent. Mocked elapsed time is not a day-long wall-clock test.

scope: Socket close and real alarm invoked under mocked Date.now; error callback inspected but not separately injected.
